product_summary: A match-intelligence companion that helps global football fans choose, understand, and follow decisive World Cup fixtures in their local time.
audiences: Global viewers choosing which fixture matters now
Small groups coordinating a shared watch

application_concept.primary_job: Choose the next World Cup match to watch with enough context to understand its stakes.
application_concept.success_moment: A fan has selected a fixture, understood why it changes the bracket, and opted into a local-time reminder.
differentiation: The first screen is a navigable match-orbit rather than a score-card grid.
Tournament consequences remain co-present with local-time planning.

primary_regions.name: Tournament orbit
primary_regions.role: Select a fixture by its stage and live relevance.

primary_regions.name: Match intelligence panel
primary_regions.role: Read local kickoff, scenario, and the next consequence.

primary_regions.name: Follow-up strip
primary_regions.role: Coordinate a reminder or shared watch without leaving the match.

first_screen_contract: An actual selectable match orbit and a selected fixture must appear above the fold.
Kickoff in the viewer's local time and one concrete tournament consequence must be visible before any promotional content.

signature_moves: Fixtures sit on a stage-based orbital path whose distance conveys tournament progression.
The selected fixture opens as an editorial match brief with a visible next consequence.

notes: Semantic OS Markdown is the only color authority for this project.
No colors were sampled from an existing World Cup screen.
No visual references are intentionally attached. The product ontology is the visual source of truth.
Disabled: this exploration must not depend on existing screens.

component_decision.rationale: World Cup Orbit helps a fan make one informed viewing decision. Every core component either locates a fixture in the tournament, explains its consequence, or lets the fan follow it in local time.

core_components.name: orbit-shell
core_components.role: Canvas frame that keeps tournament stages and selected match co-present.
core_components.decision_reason: The decision depends on spatial context, not a feed.
content_rules: Keep the selected fixture visible when the orbit changes.
accessibility_notes: Provide a list alternative for the spatial canvas.

do: Use stage order as the primary hierarchy.
dont: Replace the canvas with a generic card grid.

core_components.name: stage-rail
core_components.role: Shows tournament stages and filters the orbit.
core_components.decision_reason: Fans need a simple way to narrow the tournament without losing progress context.
content_rules: Use real stage names and counts.
accessibility_notes: Use tabs with an announced active stage.

dont: Hide the active stage in color alone.

core_components.name: match-orbit-node
core_components.role: One selectable fixture placed in its tournament stage.
core_components.decision_reason: A compact node lets fixtures stay comparable while retaining stage position.
content_rules: Show local kickoff or live minute, never both as decoration.
accessibility_notes: Use a named button with teams, time, and stage.

dont: Turn each node into a full score card.

core_components.name: attention-brief
core_components.role: Editorial summary of a selected match and its concrete stakes.
core_components.decision_reason: Fans need the why-now answer before they commit time.
content_rules: Use a single verifiable stakes sentence.
accessibility_notes: Keep heading order and time zone explicit.

core_components.name: knockout-path
core_components.role: Shows the next bracket destination caused by a fixture result.
core_components.decision_reason: Tournament consequence needs a concrete destination, not an abstract probability.
content_rules: Name the result condition on every connector.
accessibility_notes: Supply a text sequence for the diagram.

core_components.name: local-time-ribbon
core_components.role: Converts kickoff into the viewer's local time and reminder state.
core_components.decision_reason: Local-time clarity makes the product useful across the world.
accessibility_notes: Do not rely on relative time alone.

core_components.name: follow-match-control
core_components.role: Sets a reminder and optional watch-circle visibility for a fixture.
core_components.decision_reason: The product's success moment ends with a concrete follow action.

data_contract.follow: fixture id, user preference, reminder time

content_rules: State the exact reminder outcome after activation.
accessibility_notes: Use pressed state and polite confirmation.

do: Keep the action tied to one match.
dont: Prompt for a social action before follow is chosen.

rejected_components.name: odds-panel
rejected_components.reason: The product helps fans understand tournament stakes, not place bets.

rejected_components.name: metric-card-grid
rejected_components.reason: Counts do not help choose a fixture.

rejected_components.name: generic-hero
rejected_components.reason: The task surface must start immediately.
